title: Benchmarks Are Not Monolithic: Sample-Level Auditing and Orchestration for LLM Evaluation

bias_targets.methodology: Annotating benchmark dataset samples for the presence of implicit or explicit stereotypes on a 0-3 ordinal scale using an LLM-as-a-judge protocol, and subsequently evaluating model performance on the highly stereotyped subsets.

Evaluating benchmark dataset samples for cultural or political framing, specifically identifying items that require a subjective stance or rely heavily on localized (e.g., US-centric) cultural assumptions using an LLM-as-a-judge protocol.
